Definition
[Majorizes] 1. ch4:4.6.2-def-2\group Power Series Methods For $f=\sum f_\alpha x^\alpha $ and $g=\sum g_\alpha x^\alpha $, write $g\gg f$ if $g_\alpha \ge |f_\alpha |$ for every multiindex $\alpha $.
